query: Hedy Lamarr recruited George Antheil composer met MGM "Secret Communication System"
notes: Hosts: invent.org (inductee page and blog), prologue.blogs.archives.gov (the existing NARA source LAM-S-0044), airandspace.si.edu, sirismm.si.edu finding aid PDF, americanhistory.si.edu SOVA items, invention.si.edu, arxiv.org. Checked invent.org/inductees/hedy-lamarr and invent.org/blog/inventors/hedy-lamarr text: both say Lamarr worked with Hollywood composer George Antheil, but neither says she recruited him or met him through MGM Studios. Only the NARA Prologue post states the claim; nothing staged.
